title: A worker's fix fails its check

steps.summary: the coder's fix failed its check: GET /health still returns 503 on staging (CI run 4417, job health-check)

steps.text: Where is the health check ask?

expect.name: says-it-failed
expect.question: Does the message say plainly that the fix failed, naming the failure (a 503 from /health) and its evidence (CI run 4417), and does it stand alone for a reader who saw nothing else?
